answer_1.quote: Knowledge-grounded dialogue generation, which utilizes external knowledge to enhance conversation backgrounds, has achieved promising performance.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We report accuracy (Acc) to evaluate the knowledge selection. Besides, we use the traditional indicators, i.e., perplexity (PPL), BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and Distinct-2 to evaluate the quality of response generation.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation for our model. We randomly sampled 300 generated response and then we invite six annotators to select out their preferred response (win), or vote a tie, considering the following aspects: diversity, coherence and knowledge engagement.
answer_4.guideline: considering the following aspects: diversity, coherence and knowledge engagement
